text:
laura: Quick design question — in the vectors preview export flow, should the default export button say "Export selection" or "Export with provenance" when provenance is enabled for the org? I ran into ambiguity with mixed selections across pages.

matt: Hmm, I saw users confused yesterday. They thought "Export selection" meant only visible rows. Might be worth clarifying. :thinking:

sophia: proposal: primary CTA = "Export (selection)" and a secondary caption: "Includes source & model metadata when provenance is on". That keeps the CTA short but surfaces provenance.

kevin: I like short CTAs, but accessibility wise we need the button aria-label to be explicit. e.g., aria-label="Export selected vectors including provenance metadata" when provenance toggled.

laura: good call. Also: edge case where user has "Select all matching" across pages — export should warn that selection > page. UX: small banner "Exporting N items (includes items not currently visible)". Thoughts?

matt: definitely warn. Also add copy for CSV header: currently we just emit ids+vector. We should include columns: source_id, dataset_name, model_name, model_version, embed_ts. That maps to provenance.

sophia: want to add a tiny inline help icon next to export CTA that opens a micro-tooltip: "What is provenance?" with 2 lines: "Tracks which model and dataset produced each vector. Useful for audits and rerank reproducibility." Link to docs.

kevin: accessibility nits: tooltip must be keyboard-focusable and visible to screen readers. Use role="dialog" or aria-describedby to the CTA. Also, add visible focus ring on the micro-icon.

aria-bot: (automation) Note: analytics event for export should include: export_mode, include_provenance, selection_scope, export_format.

laura: thanks bot. Another micro problem: current export filename default is "vectors.csv" — should include workspace slug and date to avoid collisions. e.g., "acme_vectors_2026-03-23.csv"

matt: yes, and for provenance-enabled exports, suffix with "_prov" so downstream tooling knows.

sophia: copyflow question: when provenance is NOT enabled org-wide, the secondary caption should show "Provenance not enabled for this workspace — enable in settings" with settings link. Keep it short.

kevin: keyboard flow: user opens preview, tabs to row, hits space to select, tabs to next button — if they select many rows, ensure cluster selectable count announced by aria-live region. e.g., "10 items selected".

laura: small dev note — backend export payload should look like:
```json
{
  "selection": "explicit|all_matching",
  "include_provenance": true,
  "columns": ["id","vector","source_id","model_name","model_version","embed_ts"]
}
```
putting this here so engineers and product can align.

matt: for rerank flows, we might add a column "rerank_score" later; let's keep columns extensible.

sophia: visual nit: in the preview toolbar the export button sits next to density controls; can we add a 6px spacer? current proximity feels cramped.

laura: agreed, I'll update the Figma and push a small variant with the extra spacer and micro-tooltip. I'll also add the aria-labels and the export filename pattern.

kevin: can you also add a11y test checklist: focus order, aria-labels, live regions, tooltip keyboard access. I can run axe on the branch.

laura: will do. Thanks all. I'll ping when Figma update is ready. :thumbsup:
